overview_description.description: Tiney is a childcare startup providing home nurseries with high-quality early years education. Tiney is on a mission to reimagine at-home childcare and unlock the potential of every child. For parents, this means easy access to an exceptional and affordable childcare community that’s built around busy modern lives. For children, this means high-quality and thoughtful play-based learning in safe settings that surpass national early education requirements. This means allowing childcare providers to focus on the children in their care, relieving the burden of running a small business, and ensuring maximum job satisfaction.

product.name: Childminder Agency Service
product.description: A service that registers, supports, trains, and quality assures childminders who provide home-based childcare.

product.name: tiney App
product.description: A digital platform that manages payments, communication, learning progress tracking, and business operations for childminders and parents.

product.name: tiney Community Nursery Service
product.description: A service enabling childminders to operate micro nurseries from non-domestic community spaces such as church halls or community centers.

product.name: Childminder Training and Onboarding
product.description: A structured training and onboarding program for new and existing childminders covering education, business skills, and regulatory compliance.

product.name: Childcare Marketplace Platform
product.description: An online platform that connects families with vetted, quality-assured childminders in their local area.
